name: Core42 Lake Mariner

timeline.event: Land clearing begins for Building 1, also known as CB-1, the first large AI/HPC building on the site.

explain: Core42 Lake Mariner is an operating AI data center in Barker, NY, owned by g42. Epoch AI estimates it draws 58 MW today.
